sourceText:
Wassail
By: Barnaby Dorfman
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:04am

Ingredients




1/2 gallon apple cider
2 cups orange juice
1/2 cup lemon juice
12 whole cloves
4 cinnamon sticks
1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg

Preparation

1 In a slow-cooker or a large pot over low heat, combine apple cider, orange juice and lemon juice. 2 Add cloves, ginger and nutmeg. Bring to a simmer. If using a slow cooker, allow to heat all day. 3 Serve hot.
